title: RPHA 91 Apex Red

specs.eps_liner_structure: Multi-Density Segmented EPS Matrix with Integrated Cooling Channels

description: The HJC RPHA 91 Apex Red is combines flip-up modular convenience with highway touring comfort, pairing a quick-flip chin bar with certified impact protection. Featuring a High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan architecture at 1634g, it combines progressive kinetic energy dissipation across DOT, ECE 22.06 certifications with an acoustically tuned ~86 dB aero profile. A plush, washable 3D comfort liner cradles Intermediate Oval head shapes with zero temple pinch for glasses wearers, locked in securely with track-proven Double D-Ring retention.

product_details.description: Functional modular helmet with P/J homologation.

sizing_fit.fit_notes: Designed for oval head shapes; may feel tight on intermediate oval heads.

technical_analysis: Features Premium Integrated Matrix (P.I.M. Plus) carbon and carbon-glass hybrid fabric shell structure paired with RapidFire II visor replacement system with 2D flat race shield and dual locking mechanism. The interior utilizes ACS Advanced Channeling Ventilation System with Multicool anti-bacterial temperature-regulating interior with pre-shaped speaker cutouts for seamless Bluetooth comms integration.
marketing_description: Experience the HJC RPHA 91 Apex Red: combining South Korea 🇰🇷 craftsmanship with RapidFire II visor replacement system with 2D flat race shield and dual locking mechanism and ACS Advanced Channeling Ventilation System with Multicool anti-bacterial temperature-regulating interior. Perfect for riders who demand uncompromised safety and aero-acoustic comfort.
yoast_title: HJC RPHA 91 Apex Red: Specs, Real-World Review & Price Guide
yoast_metadesc: In-depth review of the HJC RPHA 91 Apex Red. Tested shell weight, ECE/DOT safety rating, noise dB quietness, and fitment guide for Intermediate Oval heads.

qualitative_intelligence.visor_optical_clarity: Class 1 Distortion-Free Optically Correct shield with Pinlock 120 MaxVision anti-fog lens insert included.

introduction: Positioned in HJC's Modular lineup, the RPHA 91 Apex Red brings South Korean engineering to riders seeking balance between weight, cabin acoustics, and impact protection. Designed for an Intermediate Oval fitment, it connects daily usability with certified DOT, ECE 22.06 track safety.
story:
The HJC RPHA 91 Apex Red represents HJC's dedicated protective engineering, incorporating aerodynamic shell sculpting and multi-density EPS impact damping. Its High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan shell dampens high-speed wind resonance while multi-density EPS channels absorb kinetic energy across direct and oblique impact vectors.

On the road, intake ports channel air across the scalp, keeping cabin noise around ~86 dB at 100 km/h. For riders seeking a High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan Modular helmet tailored to an Intermediate Oval head shape, the HJC RPHA 91 Apex Red delivers verified safety and long-distance rider comfort.
